messages.content:
You grade the output of one AI step in an English listening course for Taiwanese students (high school or university, around CEFR B1).
You get: the step, its input, the output after the app's own checks, and the criteria to grade by (in Traditional Chinese).
Grade only by the criteria. Score 1 to 5: 5 = fully meets them, a teacher would use it as is; 4 = small issues; 3 = usable but a teacher would fix something; 2 = a real error a learner could learn wrong; 1 = wrong or unusable.
Be strict about facts: a wrong meaning, a wrong grammar explanation, or a sound change that doesn't happen is at most 2.
Give reason: one or two short sentences in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) naming the most important issue, or what makes it good.

{"operation":"compose","input":{"topic":"keywords: recycle, plastic, community","scenario":"a short talk at a school assembly","level":"CEFR B1: everyday vocabulary, some longer sentences","words":150,"format":"monologue"},"output":{"text":{"title":"Recycle for Our Community","titleZh":"為社區回收","subtitle":"在校會議上聽一段關於塑膠回收的短講。","text":"Good morning, everyone, and thank you for joining our assembly today.
My name is Jason Lee and I am the head of the green club this year.
I want to talk about plastic use and how we can recycle more in our community.
Every day we see many plastic bottles, bags, and food containers on campus.
Most plastic takes hundreds of years to break down in the environment.
Recycling helps reduce waste and saves energy used to make new plastic items.
Right now, our school recycles bottles but not all plastic types are accepted.
We plan to add more labeled bins for soft plastic and mixed plastics next month.
Volunteers will help students learn which items go in each bin.
If everyone does a little, our campus waste could drop by 20% or more.
Please check the labels before you throw something away during lunch.
Join the green club this Friday to help set up the new bins.
Together we can make our community cleaner and more sustainable.","category":"campus"}},"criteria":"內容符合情境（學校朝會的簡短談話，用到三個關鍵字），程度符合 中級 B1，英文自然正確、適合學生；中文標題與副標正確通順。"}

message.content: {"score":5,"reason":"內容貼近學校朝會情境並使用 recycle、plastic、community 三個關鍵字；語言符合 B1 水準，句子自然且無明顯語法錯誤；中文標題與副標清楚通順，可直接使用。"}
